name: Kirishima Touka
source:
Occupation: Part-time Art teacher

The eldest daughter of the Kirishima family. She is the kind of sister who spoils her younger brother and can't stay mad at him for a long time. Very mother-like, Touka is the one who does all of the housework. However, she is concerned about marriage as she hasn't married yet and has no experience with men at all.

'Waah! Stop kissing me whenever you feel like it!'
